title: Forms that qualify your leads with dynamic steps
summary: Each answer decides the next question or the ending. Your best leads reach the call, and everyone else is saved as a lead and starts the customer journey that fits them.
body_markdown:
A form on your landing page usually treats everyone the same. The agency with 30 brands and the person just getting started see the same questions and end on the same "Book a call" button. Your team spends the week on calls that were never going to close, and the leads who didn't qualify get nothing.


Boom's **embedded forms** now have **dynamic steps** : each answer decides what comes next. Qualify people while they answer, send only the right ones to the call and give everyone else a next step that actually helps them.


## How it works


In **Lead capture › Forms** , open a question:


- **A route per answer.** On a **One choice** , **Several choices** or **Dropdown** question, each answer has a **Go to** : the next step, a later step or an ending.
- **Ranges for numbers.** A number or scale question takes ranges, for example 1 to 9 brands or 10 or more, each with its own **Go to** .
- **A default path.** Each step has **After this step** , for when no answer has a route.


To send someone to another page, take them to an ending with a redirect link. Paths always move forward, never back to an earlier step.


## Every path is a lead


Someone who doesn't qualify for the call is still a lead. Every path has to ask for an email or a phone before it reaches an ending, and Boom checks this when you publish: if a route skips it, it tells you which one. It also warns you when a step or an ending has no answer leading to it.


Each response creates or updates the person in **People** with their answers and the ending they reached, and records the form's event. With that event, a **[customer journey](https://docs.useboom.ai/journeys)** sends each person what fits them: the booking link to whoever qualifies, the Starter plan on WhatsApp to whoever is starting out, the guide by email to whoever has no brands yet. Journeys start for people who agreed to receive messages.


## What each visitor sees


The progress bar and the step count follow each person's own path, so nobody sees "2 of 5" when their path has three steps. The button switches from **Next** to **Submit** as soon as an answer leads to the end. If someone goes back and changes their answer, they follow the new path and what they answered on the old one isn't saved.


## Try it on your page before you install it


In **Install** , choose **Test in your browser** . Paste the code into your browser's console on one of your allowed sites, and the form appears on your real page without touching your code.


## From the API and MCP


Routes can also be created with the[REST API and MCP](https://docs.useboom.ai/use-mcp) . Describe the form to your connected AI tool and it builds the questions, the routes and the endings. Boom checks the same rules when you publish.


## Turning it on


Dynamic steps come with every embedded form; there is nothing to switch on. Forms are part of the Lead Capture add-on: if you don't see **Lead capture › Forms** in your menu, write to us and we'll turn it on.


For now, routes follow a choice, number or scale answer, not the total score; the[documentation](https://docs.useboom.ai/embedded-forms#routing-answers) covers what it does today.
